_purpose: The registry of fields a claim may assert. Built from what the data ACTUALLY contains, then annotated — not written from memory, because a list written from memory knows only the fields its author remembers, and this catalogue has already lost five that way.
_the_rule: EVERY FIELD A CLAIM ASSERTS MUST BE REGISTERED HERE, and tools/verifier.py refuses a claim that asserts anything else. A field registered and never used is listed with used_on_records 0 and must say why: planned, or deprecated.

_types.boolean_or_reason: true, false, or the NAME of the reason nobody knows yet — to_be_measured, firmware_dependent. Not the same as "unknown", which says the question was asked and closed.
_types.enum_or_unknown: One of a closed set, or "unknown".
_types.match: A structured correspondence between what another system reports and a subject here, with its own evidence and the level it establishes. Its shape is in database/vocabulary/matching.json. It is the one field type that asserts nothing about the hardware: it asserts which record a report belongs to.

_three_states: Absent means nobody filled it in. "unknown" means the question was asked and nobody knows; a consumer then takes the conservative branch. null is forbidden: it carried both meanings and erased a chip family's bit depth.

analog_filter.description: Quality of the analogue stage: switchable, good, simple, weak.

bits.description: Real depth of the conversion ladder, not of its input.

chip.description: What the conversion stage is, in words. Evidence for `family`, not a substitute.

correctable.description: Whether a per-device correction profile could ever apply.

device_correction_profile.description: The measured profile itself. No record has one.
device_correction_profile._why_planned_and_not_deprecated: Carried by no record and the verifier's bucket line surfaced it as belonging to none of the three. It is NOT dead: it is the field the whole level-4 tier exists for, the measured correction profile itself, and nothing can fill it until somebody measures a device. Marked planned on 2026-11-25 so that the registry line adds up, which is the only way anyone re-reads it. The 42 records now carrying `correctable` true are the eligible population: a profile can only exist for a device that lets a signal through untouched.

device_settings.description: Settings to make ON THE DEVICE, with why and a source.

dop.description: Accepts DSD packed into PCM frames (DoP).

dsd_direct.description: Does DSD reach the analogue stage without internal processing? true, false, or the NAME of the reason nobody knows yet: to_be_measured, firmware_dependent.

dsd_max.description: Highest DSD rate accepted, named: DSD64 … DSD1024.

dsd_reconverted_to_pcm.description: Does the device bring DSD back to PCM internally? Decisive: sending DSD is then work thrown away.

family.description: Chip family, a key into chip-families/. Inheritable.

inputs.bits.description: Word width THROUGH this input. Flat across rates; see inputs.bits_above_hz.
inputs.bits._in_use_since: 2026-11-24, with the first record of the population pass: eversolo/dmp-a8, from the maker's own specification table.

inputs.bits_above_hz.description: Depth steps above a rate, where the ceiling is not flat: a path carrying 24 bits at 44.1 kHz may carry 16 at 1.4112 MHz, and it truncates in silence.

inputs.dop_possible.description: Whether this input carries DSD over DoP.
inputs.dop_possible._in_use_since: 2026-11-24, with the first record of the population pass: eversolo/dmp-a8, from the maker's own specification table.

inputs.native_dsd_possible.description: Whether this input carries native DSD at all. A property of the transport.
inputs.native_dsd_possible._in_use_since: 2026-11-24, with the first record of the population pass: eversolo/dmp-a8, from the maker's own specification table.

inputs.pcm_max_hz.description: Highest PCM rate THROUGH this input.

internal_bypass.description: A rate at or above which the device steps its own processing aside.

modulator_order.description: Order of the device's own modulator. Usually inherited from the family.

native_dsd.description: Accepts DSD over a native path, as opposed to DoP.

pcm_dsd_level_offset_db.description: Level difference between the PCM and DSD paths. Without it, any PCM/DSD comparison is invalid.

pcm_max_hz.description: Highest PCM rate the device accepts, in hertz.

provenance.description: PLANNED, not implemented. Which inlet a fact came through — probe, maker, listener, agent — as distinct from the citation. governance.json treats it as central and no record carries it.

technology.description: What the conversion stage IS: delta_sigma, r2r, discrete_dsd, fpga.

device_match._what: An assertion that something another system reports corresponds to a subject here: the announced brand and model, the OUI where there is one, the subject it resolves to, and at which level (brand, range or device).
device_match._why_not_probe: The announced string itself is free - any client already has it. The RESOLUTION is not: the string names the renderer software, not the converter, and one string covers many devices. A probe therefore establishes the question, never the answer.
device_match._never_the_key: What a system reports is never the identity. It is matched TO the identity, and a wrong match is withdrawn without touching a single fact. See database/vocabulary/matching.json.

inputs.channels.description: How many channels this input accepts. Per input, like every ceiling here: a part taking eight channels over USB commonly takes two over optical.
inputs.channels._why_it_is_here: Multichannel is not a corner case. A public listing of 600 DSD-capable converters and players carries a column for 4, 5 and 5.1 multichannel, and 24 of them fill it - four percent, concentrated at the expensive end, which is the hardware of people who look for playback settings at all. Without this field a contributor who owns one has nowhere to put the fact.
inputs.channels._never_confuse_it_with_a_consumer_SETTIN: THIS FIELD SAYS WHAT THE DEVICE ACCEPTS. It does NOT say what a consumer will send, and the two must never be merged. A player's own channel setting is the boundary of ITS cost model - the point past which its margins were never derived - so a consumer may well refuse a six-channel source while this field reads 8. Reading an 8 here as permission to answer for 8 channels would be the exact error already paid on 2026-11-20, when dsd_direct and dsd_reconverted_to_pcm were one field: two questions that look like one, about two different objects.
inputs.channels._not_in_the_level_2_criterion: Registered as planned and deliberately NOT added to level 2's field list, which names `inputs` as a whole. No decision this database serves needs the channel count, and a level is which decision becomes possible - not how many fields are filled. Adding it to the criterion would have made 27 records incomplete overnight for a field nobody asked for.

inputs.dsd_reconverted_to_pcm.description: Whether DSD arriving THROUGH THIS INPUT is brought back to PCM before conversion. Overrides the device-level field for that input only.
inputs.dsd_reconverted_to_pcm._why_per_input: Because the input receiver is where it can differ. A device may take native DSD over USB and accept DSD only as DoP on S/PDIF, and unwrapping DoP is the moment a receiver may hand PCM to the converter. The transport already varies per input in this catalogue - inputs.native_dsd_possible is false on eversolo/dmp-a8's S/PDIF and true on its USB, and smsl/d200 takes DoP on three inputs and native DSD only on USB - so the field that decides whether a consumer sends DSD at all had better be able to vary with it.
inputs.dsd_reconverted_to_pcm._precedence_is_the_cascade: A value here beats the device-level dsd_reconverted_to_pcm FOR THAT INPUT ONLY. Absent, the device-level value applies; absent there, the chip family's. Same three steps as every other field, and written down because an undocumented precedence is what cost this catalogue its predicates: three of the eight classification rules tested a predicate nobody had defined, and two of the three readings a reader could pick destroyed a class the file insists on keeping.
inputs.dsd_reconverted_to_pcm._why_dsd_direct_is_NOT_following: Deliberate asymmetry, and it is principled rather than lazy. dsd_reconverted_to_pcm asks what the INPUT STAGE does with the stream - which receiver, which unwrapping - so it belongs where receivers differ. dsd_direct asks whether the CONVERTER is reached unfiltered, which is a property of the conversion stage and the same whichever socket the signal came in by. classes.json says it in its own words: « A converter with a direct DSD path still has one when it is reached over AirPlay; the transport is what cannot carry DSD. » Splitting dsd_direct per input would re-merge the two fields that were painfully separated on 2026-11-20 - see vocabulary/fields.json, _the_field_that_fools_people.
inputs.dsd_reconverted_to_pcm._it_starts_empty_on_purpose: No record carries it, and none should until a maker or a measurement states it. A sweep of 13 manufacturers' own pages on 2026-11-24 turned up no device whose maker says it re-converts on one input and not another: the case is real and this catalogue has not met it yet. Registered as `planned` so that the first person to meet it knows they have found something, rather than contradicting the device-level value in silence.

inputs.dsd_max.description: Highest DSD rate THROUGH this input. Registered 2026-11-24 on three makers who state it per input and whom the schema could not hold: Soulution gives "1 bit/5.64 MHz" on USB and Network and NOTHING on AES, coaxial and optical; MSB gives 8xDSD on Pro USB, 4xDSD on the Renderer, "1xDSD via DoP" on S/PDIF and AES; Ferrum gives DoP 256 on USB and I2S against DoP 64 on the other four. Before this field the whole of that collapsed into one device-level dsd_max plus a boolean dop_possible, which says an input carries DSD but not how much - and the figure a consumer needs is exactly how much.

pcm_reconverted_to_dsd.description: Does the device turn PCM into DSD internally before converting? The exact mirror of dsd_reconverted_to_pcm, registered 2026-11-24 on Nagra's own sentence about the HD DAC X: « Every input signal is converted into DSD 256 format (11.2 MHz sample rate). » Every input, unconditionally. For an engine this is as decisive as the field it mirrors and in the other direction: on such a device PCM has nothing to gain from being prepared carefully, because the device will remake it as DSD256 anyway, and DSD256 is the one format that arrives without a conversion. The catalogue carried the PCM-ward field for weeks and never once asked the question this way round.

inputs.dop_max.description: Highest DSD rate THROUGH this input WHEN THE STREAM ARRIVES AS DoP. Registered 2026-11-25 on six makers who publish it and whom the schema lost every time: APL HiFi (« up to DSD128 in DoP format and up to DSD256 in NativeDSD format »), Matrix Audio (two DSD lists per USB row, one marked DoP stopping two steps below the native one), Cambridge (« Native DSD 64x to 512x, DoP 64x to 256x (USB) »), Topping (« DSD64–DSD256 (Native), DSD64–DSD128 (DoP) »), LUMIN and Burson (« Native DSD 64/128/256/512 » against « DoP64/DoP128/DoP256 »). inputs.dsd_max holds the native ceiling; this holds the other one. inputs.dop_possible stays, because it answers a different question - whether DoP works at all - and many makers state that and no rate.
